title: Website & App Tester | Remote, freelancer
description:
About Testlio

Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps us identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com .

We're looking for people in Paraguay  to help test online payments for an international payments technology company.

Requirements

• Location: Currently living in Paraguay

• Access to at least one of the following payment methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Infonet, USDC, USDT.

• Comfortable following written instructions and sharing feedback in English. 

• Frequency: Expected weekly opportunities, with occasional additional requests.

• Work type: Remote, freelance, and flexible.

You don't need access to every payment method. Having one is enough to apply!

What You'll Do

• Follow simple, step-by-step instructions from our testing team.

• Complete small, authorized test transactions using eligible payment methods.

• Check whether payments are successful or if any errors appear.

• Share your results and report issues, including screenshots when needed.

Why do we need local testers?
Payment methods work differently from country to country. A transaction that works in one country might fail in another.
That's why we need people who live locally and have access to the payment methods customers actually use.
Your role is to help us check whether payments work correctly and report any issues you find.
No previous software testing experience is required.

Privacy & Security

We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously.
You'll only be asked to complete authorized testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive account information in your reports.

Interested in joining us?
Apply through our official Testlio Work Opportunities page . If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.
All official email communications will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox!

#LI-REMOTE

title: Construction Project Risk Consultant (Full-Time)
description:
Overview
Do you have experience in project risk management and risk analysis for design and construction projects and enjoy collaborating with construction managers, contractors, owners, and designers?
MBP is looking for a project risk consultant to support qualitative and quantitative risk management tasks across market sectors including federal government, state/local government, education, healthcare, and transit. If you have experience in this area and are ready to contribute to project success, we want to hear from you.
Responsibilities
What You'll Do:
Lead and support project risk management assignments from inception through final completion. Responsibilities include:

• Lead or support project risk management assignments, in alignment with the full risk management lifecycle.

• Support development of a risk management plan.

• Coordinate with the project teams and stakeholders to facilitate the identification of risks and develop risk reports and registers, and associated risk response actions.

• Facilitate risk interviews, risk workshops, and regular risk meetings.

• Develop and utilize a Probability and Impact Matrix to rate each risk on its probability of occurrence and impact on an objective if it does occur.

• Perform quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis.

• Assist with the prioritization of risks for further analysis.

• Identify, analyze, track, record and provide guidance with respect to actions to manage and/or mitigate risks.

• Assist construction and project managers to control the risk process by continuously monitoring efforts for new, changing, and outdated risks.

Qualifications
Who We Are Looking For
Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in qualitative risk management

• Developing project risk management plans

• Facilitating project risk interviews, workshops, and update meetings

• Formulating risk mitigation strategies

• Maintaining project risk register

• Demonstrated familiarity with quantitative risk analysis

Education/Knowledge:

• Bachelor’s degree in industry-related field, advanced degree preferred

• Detailed knowledge of construction, principles of construction management and project controls

• Recent experience/technical competence in risk identification, analysis and management for projects and programs of similar scope.

• Knowledge of scheduling, cost estimating, documentation, contract administration, and construction techniques.

Preferred Certifications:

• AACE Project Risk Management Professional (PRMP)

• PMI Project Risk Management Professional (PMI-RMP)

• Certified Construction Manager (CCM)

• Professional Engineer (PE)

Skills and Abilities:

• Develop strong relationships with project stakeholders

• Exhibit interpersonal and communication skills

• Lead a team to complete tasks

• Strong verbal, written and presentation skills

• Ability to apply analytical methods and techniques as they relate to risks

• Initiate, organize and facilitate risk interviews and workshops with diverse subject matter experts

• Organizational skills to maintain and communicate risk register information.

• Demonstrated skills in Microsoft Excel and other risk register platforms

• Preferred - Demonstrated familiarity with CPM scheduling software applications (e.g. Primavera P6)

• Preferred - Demonstrated familiarity with quantitative risk analysis applications (e.g. @Risk, Primavera Risk Analysis, Acumen Risk, Safran Risk, RiskyProject, etc.)

Guidance/Responsibility:

• Able to work independently, seeking guidance and direction when required
Supervisory:

• Non-supervisory role

We’re focused on providing the tools and support you need to succeed, both personally and professionally. title: Prelitigation Paralegal
description:
Rutter Mills LLP, a leading personal injury law firm in Hampton Roads, is seeking an experienced and client-focused Pre-Litigation Paralegal to join our team. This role supports attorneys and clients throughout the personal injury claim process before a case enters litigation.

Schedule : Full-time Monday through Friday

Location: Remote

About the Role:

As a Pre-Litigation Paralegal, you will manage personal injury pre-litigation files through the demand stage while serving as a steady point of contact for clients. This position requires strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, and attorneys in a professional and compassionate manner.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage personal injury pre-litigation files through the demand stage

• Maintain regular communication with clients, medical providers, insurance companies, and attorneys

• Order, review, and track medical records, bills, lost wages, and other case documentation

• Prepare demand packages, correspondence, statements, and case summaries

• Maintain organized case files and deadlines in the firm’s case management system

• Assist attorneys with all aspects of pre-litigation case management

Qualifications

• 1-3+ years of Virginia personal injury pre-litigation experience preferred

• Understanding of auto insurance coverages, medical records, insurance claims, and personal injury workflow

• Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail

• Ability to manage a fast-paced caseload

• Experience with legal software or case management systems preferred

Why Rutter Mills?

Rutter Mills, LLP is a well-established and highly regarded personal injury firm with offices throughout Hampton Roads. Our Pre-Litigation Department plays an important role in supporting clients, attorneys, and case outcomes during the early stages of the personal injury process. We are also committed to giving back to the community through partnerships with local nonprofits and youth sports organizations, contributing time, resources, and support to the communities we proudly serve. As our firm continues to grow, this role offers long-term career potential, including opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility.

Benefits Include:

• Paid Time Off

• Health insurance

• Supportive team environment with opportunities for growth

• 401(k) with matching after 1 year

If you're organized, detail-oriented, and enjoy helping clients while managing a fast-paced caseload, we'd love to hear from you!

title: CX Learning & Development Manager
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is looking for a Learning & Development Manager to own how our CX teams, customers, and partners learn Benchling. You’ll build the self-serve courses and learning paths that reach all three, and manage the learning platform that delivers them. When it works, scientists spend their time on science, partners deliver with confidence, and the same questions stop landing in support queues. This role is for someone who is motivated by helping users succeed with a great self-serve experience.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Author courses and assessments focused on use and administration of the Benchling platform and features.

- Design and maintain the LMS content architecture across our three personas (internal, customer, partners): learning plans, course libraries, learner UX.

- Leverage learner feedback, SME input, and our product roadmap to decide what to improve, retire, or build next for each audience.

- Develop scalable onboarding and continuous learning programs for CX roles including Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support, partnering with subject matter experts across CX to turn complex product and process knowledge into engaging content.

- Deliver learning content to people where they work, including in-app guidance and help docs.

- Own our learning platform (Docebo today) like a product, focused on creating a high-quality experience for all users. Set the improvement roadmap and handle day-to-day administration.

- Use AI to shorten the path from idea to published course.

- Increase program effectiveness, completion, and engagement. Connect learning to product adoption and customer retention.

- Refine and execute on governance processes for eLearning content lifecycle management: creation, review cadences, version control, and deprecation.

- Collaborate with Benchling colleagues across the Knowledge & Digital Experience program to align LMS content strategy with Benchling’s broader knowledge ecosystem.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of experience in learning & development, instructional design, or enablement within a B2B SaaS company, vertical or Life Science SaaS preferred.

- Demonstrated content development skills and a track record of designing and building end-to-end curriculum, including learning paths and assessments, not just maintaining content. Can author or direct clear, engaging enablement materials without always having deep domain expertise.

- Experience working with engineering and product teams, and developing learning content focused on the use and administration of software products.

- Experience with eLearning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate Rise 360, or similar) and assessment tools (e.g. Skillable, Quest

title: Client Partner (North America)
description:

Lateral stands for technology excellence.
We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.
Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.
We do things differently at Lateral
Our mission is simple: design and build great products .
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:
We Have A Bias For Action & Results
We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.
We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality
Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.
We Care Deeply
We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage. Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.
We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do
Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.
We Keep Improving
The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.
We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto
We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership

Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

• Identify and convert new opportunities within existing and new accounts. You’ll know how to move from a first conversation to a signed engagement with clarity and confidence.

• Partner with Delivery and Technical Leads to ensure projects align with client goals and deliver tangible business results.

• Be the voice of the client inside Lateral translating their commercial objectives into clear internal focus.

• Develop and execute account strategies: mapping stakeholders, anticipating needs, and expanding our footprint through trust and results.

• Represent Lateral externally - you’ll already have a network you can activate on day one.

• Stay close to delivery without being in it: you’ll track satisfaction, renewals, and the health of the partnership, ensuring we keep raising the bar.

What We’re Looking For
We’re looking for a self-starting, commercially driven operator who thrives at the intersection of business development and delivery excellence.
You must bring:

• Proven commercial results. You’ve personally led complex deals from 0% to 100% and can walk us through how you built the relationship, structured the opportunity, and closed it.

title: ProAdmin Solutions Director
description:
About the Role
WinTech is seeking an experienced professional to accelerate growth of ProAdmin, our defined benefit calculation engine, used on its own and embedded within pension administration systems. You will shape our go-to-market strategy and build relationships across the plan sponsor ecosystem including plan sponsors, Pension Administration System (PAS) partners, and pension consultants. The role has two parts: building partnerships with PAS vendors that embed ProAdmin, and selling directly to plan sponsors who want greater confidence in their benefit calculations.

What You Will Do

• Build and execute a strategy aligned to our growth objectives.

• Lead each opportunity end to end, from finding and qualifying prospects through closing and onboarding new customers and partners.

• Build and manage PAS partnerships: identify and prioritize vendors, negotiate commercial agreements, and run joint pursuits where ProAdmin is embedded as the calculation engine.

• Earn the trust of plan sponsor leaders, PAS partners, and pension consultants through a working knowledge of how plan sponsors operate and what they need.

• Show plan sponsors how ProAdmin addresses problems such as calculation errors and the need for confidence in benefit calculations.

• Represent WinTech at industry events.

What You Bring
You know the defined benefit (DB) market and how plan sponsors work, and you have a record of building pipeline and growing revenue.

• 10+ years of experience in business development or pension consulting within the DB plan space. Public sector experience is required; private sector experience is a plus.

• Knowledge of who makes and influences decisions at plan sponsors, and comfort working with fund administrators, executive directors, technology leaders, and consultants.

• A record of closing long, complex deals with several decision-makers, RFPs, and board or executive sign-off.

• Experience building channel, OEM, or technology partnerships, including negotiating commercial terms and co-selling with partners.

• Sound commercial judgment and strong communication and relationship skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, retirement services, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.

• Ability to travel as needed.

Nice to Have
Any of the following will help you get up to speed faster.

• Experience selling pension software, actuarial or pension consulting services, or other retirement technology.

• Familiarity with plan sponsors, PAS providers, pension consultants, and retirement technology platforms.

Why Join Us
This role gives you the opportunity to shape WinTech’s growth, build senior relationships across the plan sponsor ecosystem, and influence how we bring ProAdmin to market. You will work across WinTech to turn customer needs and market intelligence into opportunities for both our clients and our business.
We are building this part of the business, so the role will evolve and you should be comfortable with shifting priorities.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• A Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS) or Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS) certification

Coherence OS is an AI-native operating system focused on preserving human meaning, identity, and ethical coherence in the age of advanced automation.

We are building foundational infrastructure intended to support long-lived, global-scale systems - not short-term SaaS experiments.

This role is for someone who wants to contribute to systems that will matter over time.

Most candidates who recognize the long-term value of access over one-time payment choose Option 2.

Due to the nature of this work and the role it plays in expanding access globally, priority will be given to candidates who select Platform Access

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

title: Google Ads Strategist
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

•

description:

The Role

We're hiring for a Head of SEO to own organic search presence across our iGaming and Rewards propositions in the UK and US. This is a build role: you'll set the strategy, hire the team and put the tooling and processes in place to execute.

You'll turn organic search into a predictable, compliant growth channel measured on commercial outcomes, not just rankings. That means registrations, purchases and revenue for iGaming, and sign-ups and active members for Rewards.

You'll look after four sites: cashback.co.uk http://cashback.co.uk, joincustard.co.uk http://joincustard.co.uk, strikewild.co.uk http://strikewild.co.uk and slotswise.com http://slotswise.com.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

STRATEGY AND OWNERSHIP

- Set and own the organic search strategy for iGaming and Rewards across the UK and US, with clear targets and a 12-month roadmap

- Prioritise by commercial value: focus effort on the verticals, states, merchants and page types that drive purchases, revenue and member growth

- Own the SEO budget and make the case for investment in people, tools, content and links

- Work closely with commercial, paid, CRM, brand and compliance teams so SEO priorities match merchant deals and launch plans

BUILDING THE TEAM

- Hire and lead a team from scratch, starting with the roles the roadmap needs most (for example, technical SEO, content SEO, outreach)

- Decide what to build in-house and what to outsource, and manage agencies and freelancers where it makes sense

- Set the processes, playbooks and tooling the team runs on

TECHNICAL SEO

- Own site health across our properties: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data and internal linking

- Work with product and engineering to put SEO into templates, releases and migrations from the start

- Build scalable page frameworks for reviews, comparisons, offers and state or market landing pages

CONTENT AND AUTHORITY

- Set the content strategy and editorial standards, with E-E-A-T and YMYL expectations built in

- Lead a safe, sustainable approach to digital PR and link acquisition in competitive, closely watched SERPs

- Shape our approach to AI-powered search, AI Overviews and generative engine optimisation (GEO) so our brands are cited and trusted

MARKETS AND COMPLIANCE

- Run distinct UK and US plans that reflect each market's regulation, search behaviour and competition

- Plan US state launches so content and authority are ready ahead of go-live

ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

Within AISim, ChemSim is SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. We are seeking an exceptional Product Manager to advance our AI/ML products. This is a dual-mandate role. In the near term, you will be the product owner for one of our ChemSim verticals within SandboxAQ's $500M CHIPS Act R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce, translating contractual objectives into product requirements and external fulfilment, whilst partnering with Program Managers to ensure successful milestone delivery. In parallel, you will build the commercial foundation that turns our ChemSim work from government-funded R&D workstreams into a product-led business generating durable, recurring revenue from the broader materials and process-chemistry market.

Materials science and industrial chemistry are among the largest and most consequential application areas in applied science. ChemSim spans catalysis, batteries, magnets and alloys, and PFAS replacements: four verticals that underpin refining and downstream oil and gas, commodity and petrochemical production, emissions control, and the energy transition, alongside semiconductor substrates and process chemistry, energy storage, and fine chemical synthesis. Across nearly all of these markets the bottleneck is the same: materials discovery and optimization remain slow, experimental and expensive, and the simulation tools available today answer narrower questions than the ones that actually decide a product or process. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the end-to-end product strategy for a ChemSim product inlcuding vision and roadmap, spanning CHIPS Act contractual deliverables, vertical scientific depth, and commercial expansion into new markets.

- Build a deep understanding of customer needs by working closely with Application Scientists and the Business Development team. Synthesize field insights, application benchmarking data, and market feedback into a clear picture of customer personas, and performance drivers, and translate these into prioritized product requirements and specifications.

- Translate the program's objectives into clear product requirements, a vertical roadmap, and the evidence packages required for Fulfillment Notices to the U.S. Department of Commerce.

- Define the dataset and model requirements for the vertical, chemical coverage, fidelity, and the benchmarking that determines where simulation investment is directed in partnership with our scientific and ML teams.

title: Risk and Outsourcing Officer, Payments Business
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are seeking a hands-on Risk & Outsourcing Officer for Vinted Pay Limited, our FCA-authorised UK Electronic Money Institution. As the entity's second line of defence for operational risk, internal controls and outsourcing, you will build and run the frameworks that let Vinted Pay Limited scale its services safely and in line with FCA expectations. You will work directly with the Vinted Pay Limited Board and senior management, and closely with Compliance, the MLRO, Finance, Legal, Information Security; as well as the Group Risk, Controls & Internal Audit team. Your job is to give the Board a clear, reliable view of the entity's risk profile, keep intra-group and third-party outsourcing under control, and make sure new products and changes are risk-assessed before they go live. If you want to shape a risk function at an early stage rather than inherit a finished one, and you can translate regulation into pragmatic, proportionate controls, this role is for you.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own and maintain Vinted Pay Limited's operational risk, internal controls and outsourcing policies, procedures and risk register - aligned with Group frameworks and adapted to UK regulatory requirements - and keep them current as the business evolves.

• Own the outsourcing register, and run the outsourcing lifecycle for intra-group and third-party service providers: materiality and risk assessments, coordinating due diligence with Information Security, Legal, Compliance and Procurement, contract and SLA requirements, ongoing monitoring, exit plans and related FCA notifications.

• Own the New Product Approval Process (NPAP) for the entity, so that new products, material changes and initiatives are risk-assessed before launch.

• Run the risk monitoring framework end-to-end - track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) against risk appetite and tolerances, escalate breaches, and produce clear risk reporting and dashboards for the Board and its committees.

• Coordinate the entity's internal controls plan with process owners and track remediation of control gaps, audit findings and regulatory actions.

• Monitor and support the management of operational incidents with Group teams and ICT, including root-cause analysis, lessons learned, and readiness for the FCA's operational incident and third-party reporting rules (PS26/2) coming into force in March 2027.

description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

- Help decide what gets built, not just how. Challenge assumptions, suggest alternatives, and help define requirements before anyone writes code.

- Engineer with AI, responsibly. Use agentic workflows and AI tooling every day while you stay accountable for architecture, security and quality. You'll also help shape how our team builds with AI.

- Build the new and improve the existing. Your time splits roughly evenly between new product capabilities and modernising an established codebase. Every area you touch should be better when you leave it.

- Work beyond your team's walls. Spot dependencies with our other teams early, raise risks before they block delivery, and keep stakeholders informed.

- Deliver as a team. Join four talented engineers who share ownership. You'll work in four-month terms with two-week sprints, keep rituals lean, and adjust scope when reality changes.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

- The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world

- Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs

- Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market

- Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget

- Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - King William
Job Location: Work at Home, Virginia, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen. In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Tu transformeras des problématiques complexes en analyses de données concrètes, modèles exploitables et périmètres de migration clairement définis, tout en collaborant tout au long du cycle de vie des solutions avec les Product Managers, Business Analysts, développeurs et autres partenaires. - Participer activement aux revues de code et aux sessions de résolution de problèmes collaboratives, en contribuant à l’amélioration des solutions IA et des processus de développement.

- Dépanner et résoudre les problèmes liés à l’IA, en garantissant la fiabilité et la précision des applications pilotées par IA.

- Te tenir à jour des dernières avancées en IA et machine learning, des publications et des outils, et les intégrer dans les projets IA.

- Développer les infrastructures pour la transformation et l’ingestion des données.

- Collaborer avec l’équipe Corporate Data pour valider, fusionner et obtenir les bonnes données alignées aux cas d’usage business.

- Analyser les données des systèmes actuels, créer des procédures de nettoyage et de réconciliation.

- Interpréter les résultats des analyses de données pour guider la prise de décisions au sein de l’organisation.

Ce que tu dois apporter :

- Diplôme en informatique, en systèmes d’information de gestion ou équivalent

- Expérience avec des produits GCP comme BigQuery, Vertex AI, Conversational Agent

- Expérience du SDLC incluant Agile, CI/CD, environnements cloud (AWS, GCP)

- Bonne connaissance de la gestion des données, de l’intégration, de la qualité et du développement de bases de données

- Capacité à appliquer les principes de Data Governance (lineage, qualité, métadonnées)

- Solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec la capacité de rester positif et motivé sous pression

- Expérience confirmée en IA avec un portfolio de projets réussis

- Maîtrise de langages de programmation couramment utilisés en IA, comme Python, R ou Java

- Expérience pratique en NLP, vision par ordinateur ou autres sous-domaines IA

- Expérience avec des systèmes de contrôle de version comme Git pour collaborer efficacement

- En tant qu’entreprise mondiale comptant des employés et des clients à l’extérieur du Québec, la maîtrise de l’anglais comme langue de travail est requise pour ce poste.

title: Lead Sales Engineer, Enterprise
description:
From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran , customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
About the Role
Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.
We’re looking for a talented German speaking Senior Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will work closely with our sales team to understand our Enterprise customers’ complex business needs and showcase how Fivetran ’s data replication solutions can help them achieve their desired business outcomes. You will be responsible for providing technical expertise, identifying technical requirements, and ensuring a successful proof-of value throughout the sales cycle.
This is a full-time remote position based in Germany, with preference for Munich.
Technologies You’ll Use
AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, New Relic, Linux, Windows, Python, Java
What You’ll Do

• Work with Enterprise customers to understand their business, their use cases, and their data replication requirements

• Develop and deliver technical presentations to Enterprise audiences

• Ensure the technical win by running an organized proof-of-value process

• Work closely with multiple cross-fuctional organizations driving change and improvements to Fivetran as a whole.

• Work closely with multiple Sales representatives, while maintaining a high level of customer focus and technical excellence

• Stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends in our industry

• Assist team members in advanced technical or business roadblocks

Skills We’re Looking For

• Native/Professional Proficiency in German

• 5+ years in data replication, sales engineering, or related technical field

• Strong technical background covering database replication, cloud infrastructure, and data replication technologies with some form of hands on experience

• Experience with modern data analytics technologies, including cloud data warehouses, transformation tooling, data catalogs, and BI tools

• Excellent communication and presentation skills with a keen ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

• Experience with Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MySQL, and NoSQL databases

• Hands on experience with other data replication or ETL tools

• Experience with self-hosted software application

title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Valley, AL

Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes - no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.
Requirements
• Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
• Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
• You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply
Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.
